exposure: Individual counselling regarding Postpartum Intrauterine Contraceptive Device (PPIUCD)
outcome: Knowledge regarding Postpartum Intrauterine Contraceptive Device (PPIUCD)
cohort: The study participants were 60 primi mothers (women giving birth for the first time) from Talera Hospital and Bhosri Hospital.
finding: Individual counselling significantly improved knowledge regarding Postpartum Intrauterine Contraceptive Device (PPIUCD) among primi mothers.
